name: Ceylon Royal Blue Sapphire
description: Mined from the sacred alluvial gravels of Ratnapura near Adams Peak. Awakened through traditional 1,800°C wood-charcoal thermal metallurgy to reveal pure, permanent chromatic depth. 100% natural thermal enhancement; zero beryllium, zero glass resins. Preserved unmounted as an asset-grade loose crystal.
